At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

abilities.name: Sweeping Fervor
_curatorNotes: Shield spawns at skillShieldStart=28f. Shield has 3 levels (Level 1: 0–1 hits, Level 2: 2 hits, Level 3: 3+ hits; with A1 passive: Level 2=1 hit, Level 3=2+ hits). All levels share 12s duration but have different HP values scaling with DEF (HP = shieldLevelN_Flat + shieldLevelN_coeff * DEF) — scaling buff, value not authored per recipe.
Level 3 shield (Rave) deals Pyro DoT every 2s (120f) via shieldDot in skill.go. Not modeled in summons[] — no schema field for a DoT attached to a shield entity. Reviewer to decide representation.

C2 constellation also creates a Level 3 shield at burstShieldStart=43f of burst animation (gcsim: burst.go, c.Base.Cons >= 2 branch). Not modeled in burst summons[]. Reviewer to check C2 effects entry.
abilities.description:
Xinyan brandishes her instrument, dealing Pyro DMG on nearby opponents, forming a shield made out of her audience's passion.
The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Xinyan's DEF and on the number of opponents hit.
·Hitting 0–1 opponents grants Shield Level 1: Ad Lib.
·Hitting 2 opponents grants Shield Level 2: Lead-In.
·Hitting 3 or more opponents grants Shield Level 3: Rave, which will also deal intermittent Pyro DMG to nearby opponents.

The shield has the following special properties:
·When unleashed, it infuses Xinyan with Pyro.
·It has 250% DMG Absorption effectiveness against Pyro DMG.

abilities.name: Riff Revolution
abilities.description:
Strumming rapidly, Xinyan launches nearby opponents and deals Physical DMG to them, hyping up the crowd.
The sheer intensity of the atmosphere will cause explosions that deal Pyro DMG to nearby opponents.

passives.name: "The Show Goes On, Even Without an Audience..."
passives.description:
Decreases the number of opponents Sweeping Fervor must hit to trigger each level of shielding.
·Shield Level 2: Lead-In requirement reduced to 1 opponent hit.
·Shield Level 3: Rave requirement reduced to 2 opponents hit or more.

constellations.name: Impromptu Opening
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger. In gcsim this is a permanent AttackMod (not an onCast buff): applies +100% CRIT Rate only to burst Physical DMG hits (filters AttackTagElementalBurst + Physical element in cons.go c2()). Not a general critRate buff. Probable trigger: always-on conditional AttackMod when C2 is active — no standard onCast/onHit trigger fits directly. C2 also creates Level 3 shield at burstShieldStart=43f on burst cast (gcsim burst.go); not in effects. Reviewer to decide trigger and correct scope.

constellations.name: Rockin' in a Flaming World
_curatorNotes: Scaling buff: C6 grants ATK bonus = 50% of DEF on Charged Attacks (description: 'ATK Bonus equal to 50% of her DEF'). Generator stat field 'def%' is incorrect — the effect adds ATK proportional to DEF, not a DEF% buff. value field deleted per scaling-buff rule. C6 is not implemented in gcsim (cons.go: function body commented out). Also models 30% stamina reduction on CA (not in effects). Inherited manual trigger; likely always-on AttackMod for CA. Reviewer to author correct representation.
constellations.description: Decreases the Stamina Consumption of Xinyan's Charged Attacks by 30%. Additionally, Xinyan's Charged Attacks gain an ATK Bonus equal to 50% of her DEF.
